## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      8 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 16, 2026 - Nov 10, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _norcal185785_, Nov 8, 2026, 1/5: "Easily the most glitchy app I’ve ever used. Constantly logs me out, doesn’t save meals or recipes I create, half the time it freezes and doesn’t respond to my attempts to scroll, won’t let me edit meals, doesn’t have any of the verified foods anymore, the import recipe feature has never once worked and I always end up imputing them by hand, the serving sizes and amounts is lists for meals in the app is not accurate and not easy to understand, the paid version is ridiculously expensive when it used to all be free, and within the last few years it has become absolutely riddled with ads."
            2. _Marjoleinloes_, Sep 20, 2026, 1/5: "This used to be my most used app, I switched from paid to free several times. The last update however made this app completely unusable. Hopefully it changes back very soon, otherwise I have to find a new app that works. Sorry, but never had an update on any app which really made an app grom great to terrible. Who decided on this???"
            3. _LoriLins64_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
